handoff_diagnosis.finding: When /init starts without an initial console, standard descriptors may be missing. Udev initializes manager sockets before make_null_stdio, which runs only below debug log level. Reserving missing stdio before invoking stock udev removes the observed handoff failure without skipping stock shutdown.
